The score and the three witness runs are one-shot measurements driven by steps 2 and 14; their records are in `evidence/`, and the two reader entries assert those records. A reader writes nothing, so neither carries an `artifact` key. The witness run is also each new kill case's remove-the-guard reading: its mutant is the guard neutralised and `caught` is the test red.
